_comment: MXM Modal Synth's collection roles. Only controls whose meaning matches a role are claimed.
osc1.wave is Model, what sounds (the modal resonator, the string, the strings, the dark FM
voice); osc1.tune is Coarse, the pitch about the note.
fx.reverb is Space: more of it spreads the voice, then adds the room's reverb.
No envelope role: Contour shapes the exciters' envelope, and no envelope reaches the sound
until a route aims one there. No filter role: Brightness and Damping are the resonator's, and
voice.note_priority is the voice mode (Poly, Mono, Legato), a key assign.
No route amount is claimed: a slot moves with its routing, so no knob could keep one meaning.
lfo1.sync and lfo2.sync stay empty, as on every instrument until the collection maps syncs.
